title: Revise the continuity-of-care goal and its mappings
requirements:
- Add referral, transition-of-care, medication reconciliation and scheduling capabilities as operational dependencies
- State that clinical knowledge is current, computable and updated as standards of care evolve
- Make shared care plans visible to individuals and caregivers as well as health workers
- Show that decision support may be realised by several mechanisms and must allow person-centred exceptions
- Use 'capabilities' where several conditions are meant
- Address referral, care-plan and medication reconciliation, or state where they sit
- Address identity-matching quality, cross-jurisdiction continuity and proportionate access
